intro: Kaplak is an orc rogue trainer stationed in Razor Hill in central Durotar. He instructs young orcs and trolls in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft, preparing them for service to the Horde before dispatching them into Orgrimmar.

p: Tucked away in the settlement of Razor Hill, Kaplak serves as a foundational instructor for fledgling Horde rogues emerging from the Valley of Trials. Where traditional orc culture glorifies open combat and roaring charges, Kaplak teaches the colder, quieter disciplines necessary for survival: stalking unseen, picking locks, and striking lethal blows from behind. Once his students outgrow his tutelage in the dusty red ravines of Durotar, he directs them north to the capital of Orgrimmar to deepen their craft among senior guild operatives.
